The Pine tree can be found in the Snow biome, the base of the snowy mountain, and areas in the Taiga biome near where it connects to the Snow biome. Similar to Spruce trees in appearance, it can be identified by its rounder "leaves" and darker, richer bark color, looking quite like a miniature Sequoia, though with smoother bark.
